summary: The candidate reproducibly fixes duplicate decoded-text loss in the list-shaped Chat Completions and Responses serving outputs and fixes the wrong surviving value in the legacy dictionary. It is a narrow partial fix: the direct/legacy dictionary still collapses duplicate text and original token bytes remain unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: At the recorded base, actual checkout import returned 2 rather than 3 entries and retained -2.5 rather than -0.5.
Candidate regression tests exercised Chat, Responses, missing positions, unique candidates, and legacy fallback; 4 passed.
Adjacent serving behavior; 189 tests and 72 subtests passed.
Serialized Chat and Responses retained all ordered duplicate candidates; mixed prompt/output alignment passed; legacy collapse, reconstructed bytes, and unsorted first-entry behavior were confirmed.
Candidate archive log contains trailing whitespace at reports/j-7c3ec2d6e068/pytest.log:7; no product-source functional failure.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU was used. The reviewed change is CPU response shaping. The original four-H200 TP4 model workload and weights are unavailable, and the assigned AMD gfx950-class GPU cannot qualify it.

remaining_counterexamples: The direct and legacy LogProbs.top_logprobs dictionary still has two keys for three candidates with duplicate decoded text.
Legacy Completions cannot serialize two candidates sharing the same decoded-string dictionary key.
Byte-fallback token identity is not carried; U+FFFD is still emitted with reconstructed UTF-8 bytes [239, 191, 189].
For deliberately unsorted duplicate candidates, the legacy projection retains the first encounter rather than selecting the maximum logprob.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 weights or four NVIDIA H200 GPUs were available; the original TP4 serving workload was not reproduced.
The prepared environment exposes one AMD gfx950-class ROCm GPU, which is not architecture-equivalent to the reported system.
No native files changed and repository-environment.json reports no native build target, so native rebuilding was not applicable.
Raw review evidence is retained at /job/review-evidence-j-3098bbfe6d18 outside the checkout.
